ambiguity.detail: Alexander states he was buried three years ago, leaving his survival and return shrouded in mystery.

verdict.hook_line: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: And I am bringing my wife home.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A powerful, presumed-dead duke returns in winter splendor to reclaim his house and rescue his wife.
verdict.why_it_works: Delivers an instant revenge-fantasy hook with striking visual production value and an ultimate swagger declaration.
